current_answer: As checked on November 2, 2026, Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list Grand Theft Auto VI for November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. No new official date change was found in the pages checked. Current US, Spain, and New Zealand PlayStation Store pages still list different PS5 unlock times. Review-code distribution and a November 18 embargo remain reported, not official; they do not establish a finished or certified build or guarantee delivery. No official native PC date or window has been announced.

catalogue_card.question: Is GTA 6 still on for November 19?
catalogue_card.text: Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Reviews are reported for November 18, not officially confirmed. Regional PS5 unlock times differ.

summary: Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. No new official date change was found in the pages checked.

The US PlayStation Store lists November 19 at 05:00 UTC; Spain lists November 18 at 23:00 UTC; New Zealand lists November 18 at 11:00 UTC. These regional listings may change and do not establish a Rockstar-wide global hour. Rockstar Support says preload begins November 12 at local midnight; preload is not playable access.

NateTheHate2 posted that review codes had begun going to media and named November 18 as the embargo date. Insider Gaming says it independently verified the review date and reports copies allegedly went out near the end of October. Neither is an official Rockstar or Take-Two announcement; no recipient is named in the report.

If accurate, review access supports the limited conclusion that review operations are being scheduled. It does not establish that the game has gone gold, is final or certified, or cannot be delayed. Two earlier official target movements remain relevant.

GinjFo reports that a Cyberleek-branded account posted an October 21 return notice and an October 28 poll, but says it found no new gameplay footage it could independently authenticate. The account and any complete build remain unverified; see the November 2 report for the claim history and limits.
No official native PC release, date, or window has been announced. GamesBeat reports Q1 2027 from four anonymous sources; Rockstar did not respond before publication.
Take-Two scheduled its fiscal Q2 2027 results for November 9 at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time. The event notice does not promise a GTA VI update.
Analytics were unavailable. Pool visits, source checks, choices, return use, and revenue remain unknown.
uncertainty: November 19 remains a public console commitment, not a delivery guarantee; Rockstar has moved the public target twice before.
Review-code distribution and the November 18 embargo are reported, not first-party announcements. The code claim has no named recipient; Insider Gaming does not explain its independent verification.
Review access does not establish a gold, final, or fully certified build and does not make another delay impossible.
PS5 Store timestamps are regional listings that can change; they are not one global publisher announcement. The checked Xbox Store page lists no exact hour.
The Q1 2027 PC window is an unconfirmed GamesBeat report from four anonymous sources.
GinjFo reports a Cyberleek-branded return notice and poll, but no new material it could authenticate. The account, messages, and full-build claim remain unverified.
The November 9 results call is scheduled, but its notice does not promise GTA VI release guidance.
The analytics broker was unavailable; reader behavior and product value remain unknown.
freshness_note: Checked November 2, 2026. The November 19 PS5 and Xbox Series X|S commitment is unchanged. Regional PS5 Store times remain different. Review-code distribution and the November 18 embargo are still reported, not official. Take-Two’s next scheduled results are November 9; the event itself is not release evidence.
